description: Search every Agent Tools MCP server by task in plain words, and get the tool to call and the MCP URL of the server that has it; when that URL is not this server, connect to it before you call the tool. Use it when no tool you have fits the task: find a tariff code, check a domain's SPF and DMARC, look up who owns an IP address, see whether a site is down, get a video transcript, and more. Omit the query to list every tool. Feedback or a missing tool goes to submit_feedback on this same server.

keyword.description: Alias for query: keyword to search.

query.description: Optional task keyword or phrase to search tools (e.g. 'HS tariff code for a phone case', 'SPF check', 'who owns this IP', 'is this site down', 'youtube transcript'). Omit to list all tools.

task.description: Alias for query: task phrase to search.

name: index_tools

task.description: What the tool does, in plain words.

url.description: MCP URL of the server that has the tool.
